title: ePiC: Employing Proverbs in Context as a Benchmark for Abstract Language Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Using an off-the-shelf neural coreference pipeline to calculate the distribution of male versus female entity mentions in the dataset's narratives, and evaluating if narratives differ in length or mention frequency based on the predominant gender.
Using the VADER sentiment analysis tool to evaluate the correlation (sentiment association bias) between the sentiment polarities of the proverbs and their corresponding crowdsourced narratives.

Qualitative evaluation in the ethics section discussing the dataset's exclusive focus on traditional English proverbs and the demographic selection biases of the crowdworkers, which may under-represent diverse cultural experiences.
